sections.title: 1 Sales:
sections.text_preview:
1.1 Selling Medicine:

1.1.1 The system should allow employees to record sales transactions, including details such as customer information, medicine name, quantity sold, and unit price.

1.1.2 Integr

sections.title: 2.1 Buying Medicine from Distributors:
sections.text_preview: 2.1.1 Employees should be able to create purchase orders for medicines from authorized distributors, specifying details like quantity, and expiration dates.

sections.title: 2.2 Inventory increase:
sections.text_preview: 2.2.1 The system should automatically update the available quantity of each purchased medicine, reflecting the increase in stock.

sections.title: 3 Reports:
sections.text_preview:
3.1 Sales Reports:

3.1.1 The system should generate detailed reports on sales activities, including daily, weekly, and monthly summaries, as well as custom date ranges.

3.1.2 Reports should include

sections.title: 3.3 Medicine Reports:
sections.text_preview: 3.3.1 Comprehensive reports on medicine inventory, including stock levels, expiration dates, and reorder suggestions, should be generated.

sections.title: 3.4 Net Profit Reports:
sections.text_preview: 3.4.1 The system should calculate and provide reports on the net profit, taking into account both sales and purchase transactions.

sections.title: 4.1 Expiration Alerts:
sections.text_preview: 4.1.1 The system should generate alerts for employees when the expiration date of a medicine is approaching, allowing timely actions such as marking for discounts or removal from shelves.

sections.title: 5.1 User Authentication:
sections.text_preview: 5.1.1 The system should have a secure login mechanism with role-based access control, ensuring that employees can only access functions relevant to their roles.

sections.title: 5.2 Activity History:
sections.text_preview: 5.2.1 A detailed activity log should be maintained for each employee, capturing actions such as logins, logouts, sales transactions, purchases, and any system operations.

sections.title: 6.1 Return to Distributors:
sections.text_preview: 6.1.1 Employees should be able to process returns of medicines to distributors within the specified time frame, recording relevant details such as reasons for return and quantities returned.

sections.title: 6.2 Inventory Update:
sections.text_preview: 6.2.1 The system should automatically adjust the available quantity of returned medicines in the inventory.

sections.title: 6.3 Stock Reduction:
sections.text_preview: 6.3.1 The return process should result in a decrease in the number of available medicines, reflecting accurate stock levels.

sections.title: 1. Performance:
sections.text_preview:
1.1 The system should respond to user interactions within two seconds under normal operating conditions.

1.2 The time taken to generate reports, should not exceed five seconds.

sections.title: 2. Reliability:
sections.text_preview:
2.1 The system should have a mean time between failures at least 500 hours.

2.2 In the event of a failure, the system should recover within five minutes with minimal data loss.

sections.title: 3. Security:
sections.text_preview:
3.1 All sensitive customer and employee data should be encrypted during transmission and storage.

3.2 Role-based access control should be enforced, ensuring that employees can only access functionali

sections.title: 4. Scalability:
sections.text_preview:
4.1 It should support the addition of new features and functionalities without requiring a complete system overhaul.

4.2 Scalability tests should be conducted to ensure optimal performance under incr

sections.title: 5. Usability:
sections.text_preview:
5.1 The user interface should be intuitive and require minimal training for new employees.

5.2 The system should provide clear error messages and guidance to users in case of input errors.

sections.title: 6. Availability:
sections.text_preview:
6.1 The system should be available 100% of the time during regular business hours.

6.2 Scheduled maintenance should be communicated in advance, and efforts should be made to minimize downtime.

sections.title: 7. Backup and Recovery:
sections.text_preview:
7.1 Regular automated backups of the database and system configuration should be performed.

sections.title: 8. Dependability:
sections.text_preview:
8.1 The system should be designed with built-in fault tolerance to minimize the impact of hardware or software failures.

8.2 Dependencies on external services or APIs should be identified.
